summary: E-commerce project with Razorpay payment integration. Improving checkout experience for both mobile and desktop users — desktop gets UPI QR code, cards, net banking, and wallets; mobile keeps direct UPI app options.
architectural_notes: Razorpay Standard Checkout (modal/popup) used for payment integration
Device detection determines payment method defaults: desktop shows UPI QR code, cards, net banking, wallets; mobile shows direct UPI app options
known_issues: Desktop Razorpay defaulted to UPI collect (push request to phone), causing friction — being fixed with QR code and card-first approach

existing_features.title: Add a device detection utility that distinguishes between mobile and desktop users based on user agent and/or screen width, and export it for use in Razorpay checkout flows.

Update the Razorpay checkout configuration in `frontend/src/hooks/useRazorpay.ts` and any direct checkout calls in `frontend/src/components/ProductCard.tsx`, `frontend/src/pages/Cart.tsx`, and `frontend/src/pages/ProductDetail.tsx` so that: on desktop, the Razorpay modal opens with `config.display.preferences.sequence` prioritising cards, then net banking, then UPI QR code (method: 'upi', flow: 'qr'), and the UPI collect/intent flow is disabled; on mobile, the existing flow is preserved with UPI apps (intent), cards, and wallets as primary options.

Ensure the Razorpay checkout modal is responsive and well-styled for both mobile and desktop screen sizes — no clipped elements, appropriate modal width on desktop, and full-screen/bottom-sheet style on mobile if supported by Razorpay's config.

new_feature_requests.summary: Improve Razorpay payment experience: device detection to show UPI QR code + cards + net banking + wallets on desktop; direct UPI app options on mobile
